sloka: प्रयाताश्च गता हर्षं मरणे कृतनिश्चयाः।चक्रुः सुतुमुलं युद्धं वानरास्त्यक्तजीविताः ।। ६.६७.३ ।।
transliteration: prayātāśca gatā harṣaṁ maraṇe kṛtaniścayāḥ।cakruḥ sutumulaṁ yuddhaṁ vānarāstyaktajīvitāḥ ।। 6.67.3 ।।

translations.english: The Vanara leaders, having been reminded of their valour in battle by Angada gladly returned with a resolve to stake their life and carried on the battle.
